title: CtrlSynth: Controllable Image Text Synthesis for Data-Efficient Multimodal Learning
summary: Long-tail generation and training descriptions contradict their stated counts/settings. No core scientific failure established in inspected pipeline/arithmetic; actual executed long-tail protocol Needs Evidence.
limitations: No source tree or separate supplement available in acquired packet.
No empirical reruns, raw-run uncertainty or contamination audit.
ImageNet validation used to select threshold; untouched-test evidence not established.
External baseline fairness acknowledged by paper, not independently resolved.

problems.title: Contradictory long-tail generation unit and training budget

source_claim.paraphrase: Seven generated samples per tail class yield80.4K/55.2K; baseline ten epochs matches listed iterations.

assumptions: Tail classes are a subset; filtering does not add samples
Use stated115.8K/62.5K originals, one GPU,batch128 and standard iteration interpretation
problems.check: Seven per class gives upper bounds7000/2555, below80400/55200. Ten real-data epochs imply9047/4883 steps, unlike55429/56429; table budgets imply61.27/115.57 epochs.
problems.result: Both written descriptions cannot simultaneously describe the reported long-tail runs.
counterevidence: Seven per original tail image or additional repeats could explain sample scale, but are unstated.
Copied pretraining iteration entries are plausible.
Actual baseline and CtrlSynth runs may still be budget matched; no score falsification established.
problems.core_dependency: Long-tail augmentation protocol supporting Table5; contradiction concerns reproducibility, not a disproved accuracy claim.
problems.impact: Minor supported description error; actual data generation and matched-budget execution Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: Supply actual generation unit/class counts, post-filter totals, sampler, effective batch and executed optimizer steps; reconcile text/table from those records.
